status: registered before expanded-data analysis; no asymptotic verdict is preset
adaptive_rule: Any additional sizes must be motivated by common-grid inter-size curve differences or coefficient drift, not by closeness of a time coefficient to the equilibrium target. Record the actual simulation decision separately. No new time window is selected to improve matching.
equilibrium_reference: Use corrected D fit from L=18 through the largest complete equilibrium size. Preserve the old L=18..90 reference separately; show every requested lower-cutoff check.
minimum_points: At least parameter count + 2. Missing endpoints or too few points produce a missing-model record, not a truncated or lower-degree substitute.
time_grid_rule: For each fixed window, choose the largest two sizes with both endpoints and at least five common measured times. Main rolling curves refit every size containing that identical grid; retain per-size full-grid fits and all-pair common-grid fits separately as diagnostics.
finite_size_metrics: Unshifted pointwise D differences, maximum window difference, and common-grid coefficient drift. Report absolute values plus normalizations using equilibrium log span and time-only fitted log span; no coefficient target is used to select the fitting window.
correction_diagnostics: Retain coefficients of inverse powers, their endpoint span relative to the log contribution, design condition numbers, RMSE, maximum residual, and model/window drift. A small residual is not sufficient evidence of an asymptotic logarithm.
finite_difference_diagnostics: s(t)=[D(2t)-D(t)]/ln2 and c_eff(t)=[2D(4t)-3D(2t)+D(t)]/ln2. Only actual complete pairs/triples; no interpolation. The second expression cancels a 1/theta correction. These do not refer to c_eq and are diagnostics only, never window/pass selectors; compare sizes before time drift.
plot_rules: Actual unshifted D curves; fits only inside their measured fit interval; stable size colors/markers; all fixed windows visible including unavailable fits; no statistical error bars or confidence claims for deterministic data.
scope: Expanded finite-size/time evidence for this one pattern and beta. Neither an equivalence theorem nor a proof that an asymptotic corner logarithm is absent. No locked previous analysis or input is overwritten.

adaptive_finite_grids.reason: Inter-size drift in complete 108/144 window 8..16; no criterion based on closeness to equilibrium coefficient.

trigger.preliminary_quoted_percentages: 21.13% coefficient drift and 5.729% curve difference used the then-available equilibrium fit through L162; completed equilibrium through L180 gives 21.144% and 5.733%, respectively.

adaptive_sampling_grids.reason: Fixed windows 6..12 and 8..16 contain only five original common times, preventing a four-parameter sensitivity fit under n >= parameters+2. Adding 9 and 11 gives seven common times without changing window boundaries; no closeness to equilibrium is used to choose these samples.

sparse_original_grid_diagnostic.rule: Repeat all seven windows after excluding the registered densification times. Keep this diagnostic separate from the primary common-grid analysis. Compare model/grid sensitivity only at the same L and same fixed window; do not mix dense and sparse size curves.
